_what: regions_at_record, per instrument, per dekad. `at_record` is how many of a country's crop regions are at their own worst on record for that point in the season; `of` is how many reported that instrument, which is why it varies.
_basis: each region against its own 2001-2025 record at the SAME dekad-of-year
_head_matches: the dekad in stress_current.json, by construction. Anchored on the published dekad rather than on the clock so the two cannot drift apart.
_restarted: 2026-09-17, on boundary layer v06 (D-301). Not comparable at region level with any copy built on v05; recomputed, not carried forward.

_window.is_derived_not_picked: every dekad of this calendar year up to the published one. Not a window somebody chose, so a within-year peak cannot fall outside it. It was 12 dekads and that WAS a choice.
_window.still_bounded_at_the_left: the year boundary. A season that began in the previous calendar year is cut, so for southern-hemisphere crops the first column can still be mid-story. Check it.
_window.before_inferring_order: check the FIRST column. If an instrument is already elevated there, its peak may precede this file and any 'X moved before Y' read from these columns is unsupported.
_window.not: evidence of sequence or of cause. `driver` in stress_current.json is unidentified for most places, including the UK and each of its four regions.
